original_finding_content.subject: Seller reports orders cancelled by Kichink for being "too cheap" (OUT OF WINDOW — undated, likely 2019)
original_finding_content.raw_text:
- **Finding ID:** F-X23
- **What:** Seller Carolina reports Kichink cancelled her orders claiming products were too cheap and prone to fraud, and views the pre-paid shipping label as the platform's only advantage.
- **Verbatim snippet:** "El servicio de kichink me pareció insuficiente y muy decepcionante pues me cancelaban órdenes diciendo que el producto era muy barato y se prestaba a fraude, la única ventaja que le veía era la guía que solo pegabas al paquete"
- **Source:** https://e-commerce.terrabionic.mx/shopify/shopify-o-kichink/
- **source_type:** blog
- **verification_status:** blocked_url_index_verified
- **Date:** Accessed April 2026; page undated
- **Notes:** OUT OF WINDOW. Seller: Carolina (comment section). Reports order cancellations by platform for low-priced products. Page not directly fetched; content verified from search engine snippets.
